# Contributing to MDMA

Start with the [controls guide](../docs/controls.md) for current behavior and the [build guide](../docs/build.md) to reproduce the official firmware.

For a bug, open an issue with your firmware version and the shortest sequence of controls that reproduces it. For a new performance feature, describe what the player should hear or see and how they would reach it on the FM-1.

For a patch, branch from `main`, keep the change focused and open a pull request describing your checks. Distinguish emulator results from tests on a physical FM-1 so reviewers can reproduce them.
